name.en-US: Commentary on the Seven Penitential Psalms

description.en-US: Fisher's seven sermons on the Penitential Psalms (1508), preached at the request of Lady Margaret Beaufort: an exposition of Psalms 6, 31, 37, 50, 101, 129 and 142, with a prologue, in the modern-spelling edition of J. S. Phillimore (Catholic Library, Manresa Press, 1914), with his preface.
description.pt-BR: Os sete sermões de Fisher sobre os Salmos Penitenciais (1508), pregados a pedido de Lady Margaret Beaufort: exposição dos Salmos 6, 31, 37, 50, 101, 129 e 142, com um prólogo, na edição em grafia moderna de J. S. Phillimore (Manresa Press, 1914), com seu prefácio.

en-US.editor: John Fisher, ed. J. S. Phillimore (London: Manresa Press, 1914)

sources.edition: This treatise concerning the fruitful sayings of David ... in the seven Penitential Psalms, ed. J. S. Phillimore, 2 vols. (London: Manresa Press, 1914), Internet Archive full-text OCR of both volumes; modern spelling, with the editor's footnote glosses.
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Fisher died in 1535; the edition is of 1914, with an editor (Phillimore) who died in 1926, so the text is public domain.
